jobs.title: Business Development Associate - Vietnam
jobs.description:
About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem.

Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.
Key Responsibilities
- Pipeline Generation & Outbound BD: Actively identify, prospect, and engage decision-makers (CTOs, Founders, Head of Web3/Digital Assets) across blockchain protocols, DeFi projects, RWA tokenization platforms, exchanges, and Web2 institutional entrants.

- Full Sales Cycle Execution: Drive complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial outreach and technical discovery to proposal creation, price negotiation, and contract execution.

- Enterprise & Institutional Sales: Engage traditional financial institutions, asset managers, family offices, and tech enterprises seeking institutional-grade security for their Web3 initiatives.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with CertiK’s global security engineering, solutions architecture, delivery, and marketing teams to ensure smooth deal execution and client onboarding.

- Account Expansion & Networking: Build long-term relationships with key accounts to drive renewals, audit add-ons, and monitoring subscriptions. Represent CertiK at local industry events, conferences, and ecosystem meetups.
Key Requirements & Qualifications
- Experience: 2–5 years of successful B2B sales or business development experience in Web3, blockchain security, cybersecurity, SaaS, or institutional fintech.

- Domain Knowledge: Strong familiarity with Web3 native ecosystems (EVM chains, Layer 1/Layer 2 protocols, DeFi, tokenomics, smart contract architectures).

- Good understanding of Web2 cybersecurity fundamentals (e.g., penetration testing, code review, risk assessments).

- Core Languages: Professional working proficiency (written and spoken) in English and Vietnamese for regional collaboration and global client management.

- Track Record: Proven ability to meet or exceed quarterly sales quotas through structured outbound outreach and consultative deal closing.

- Language & Skills Bonuses (Highly Preferred) Regional Asian Languages (Bonus): Proficiency in additional regional languages—such as Japanese, Korean, or other languages, —is a significant bonus for driving APAC cross-border expansion or local market expansion.

- Security & Audit Familiarity: Direct experience selling smart contract audits, penetration tests, or bug bounty services.

- Regulatory Context: Understanding of Vietnam’s digital asset licensing landscape is a bonus.

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

jobs.title: Business Development Intern / CertiK Ambassador
jobs.description:
About the Company
CertiK is the largest blockchain security auditor and provides a comprehensive suite of tools to secure the industry at scale. To date, CertiK has worked with over 4,900 Enterprise clients, secured over $557 billion worth of digital assets, and has detected over 18,000 vulnerabilities in blockchain code. Our clients include leading projects such as OKX, Tether, Ripple, and Pancakeswap. Our investors include top VCs like Tiger Global, Coatue Management, Shunwei Capital and Hillhouse Capital as well as industry leaders like Coinbase Ventures and Binance.


Investors = Insight Partners, Sequoia, Tiger Global, Coatue Management, Lightspeed, Advent International, SoftBank, Hillhouse Capital, Goldman Sachs, Shunwei Capital, IDG Capital, Wing, Legend Star, Danhua Capital and other investors.



The Role
- Represent CertiK at local blockchain meetups. Attend weekly crypto events, network with builders and founders, and introduce CertiK's security services when opportunities arise.
- You'll also gain: Industry experience in blockchain security and BD, direct mentorship from CertiK's partnerships team, networking with local crypto founders and VCs, and a strong resume addition with potential pipeline to full-time roles at CertiK.
Responsibilities
- Attend one local blockchain meetup per week
- Build relationships with developers, founders, and community members
- Identify business opportunities and make warm introductions to CertiK's BD team
- Time commitment:5 hours per week
Requirements
- Active in local blockchain meetups or willing to become a regular attendee
- Comfortable networking with new people
- Prior knowledge of Crypto & DeFi
Time Commitment: 5 hours per week
Compensation: $1,000 USD per month

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Singapore
jobs.description:
About the Company 
CertiK leads blockchain security by securing smart contracts and blockchains with cutting-edge Formal Verification technology. Founded by Computer Science professors of Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK has audited and secured over $500B in assets, including many of the world’s top blockchain projects.


About This Role
Singapore is where the institutional future of digital assets is being built.
As Business Development Manager for Singapore, you drive the commercial relationship with the institutions that need it — exchanges and DPT licensees, banks and financial institutions moving into tokenisation,  protocols and Web3 native teams, and the funds and infrastructure providers around them. You will run the full cycle: build the pipeline, get in front of decision-makers, understand their security and compliance problem, and close.
You will work alongside a capital markets and policy team and a technical organisation whose auditors, forensics, and on-chain surveillance work sets the benchmark for the industry.

About You
You are a builder of relationships and a closer of deals, and you are comfortable doing both in a market where the buyer is sophisticated and the sale is technical. You can hold a conversation with a CTO about smart contract risk and, an hour later, hold one with a Chief Compliance Officer about transaction monitoring and licensing obligations — and be taken seriously in both. You are self-directed about pipeline: you find the opportunity rather than waiting for it to be routed to you.
Critically, you understand that in this market a regulatory shift is a commercial event, and you know how to move first when one lands.

Responsibilities
- Pipeline generation and prospecting. Build and own the Singapore pipeline through outbound, inbound qualification, referrals, ecosystem relationships, and event presence — identifying and prioritising the accounts that matter across exchanges, financial institutions, VASPs, protocols, and infrastructure providers.

- Full-cycle deal execution. Run opportunities end to end: discovery, scoping with technical teams, proposal and commercial structuring, negotiation, and close.

- Solution positioning. Develop the depth to position CertiK’s portfolio credibly — audits and formal verification, penetration testing, on-chain surveillance and AML/compliance tooling, and incident response — and to map them to a specific client’s risk, regulatory, and commercial pressures.

- Account management and expansion. Own relationships post-sale, drive renewals and expansion, and act as the client’s primary commercial point of contact.

- Partnerships and  ecosystem. Develop channel and referral relationships with law firms, consultancies, custodians, infrastructure providers, and industry associations that extend CertiK’s reach into the market.

- Market intelligence and feedback. Track the competitive and pricing landscape, capture what you learn in the field, and feed it back into pricing, product, and go-to-market decisions.

- Cross-functional coordination. Work with policy, product, engineering, and marketing to build the proposals, materials, and campaigns that win business — and with the regional leadership team on territory strategy and forecasting.

- Reporting and CRM discipline. Maintain accurate pipeline data, forecasts, and activity records; report against clear quarterly targets.

- Ad hoc requests
Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, computer science, or a related field.

- Minimum of 4 years of B2B business development, enterprise sales, or account management experience, with a demonstrable record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.  Prior experience at a Web3 security, blockchain analytics, RegTech, or cybersecurity vendor is a plus.

- Solid working knowledge of smart contract security, on-chain analytics, AML/CFT, or virtual asset compliance concepts.  Understanding of the digital asset and blockchain landscape, and of the security and compliance problems institutions in this market face.

- Established network in the Singapore or wider Southeast Asian digital asset, fintech, or financial services ecosystem.

- Excellent written and verbal English, and the ability to present with confidence to senior and technical audiences.  Proficiency in another Asian language is a plus.

- Strong commercial instincts.

- Highly organized, self-directed, and able to run multiple opportunities and deadlines with limited supervision. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

- Existing right to work in Singapore, or eligibility to obtain one.
